summary: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report advises on the feasibility of reducing the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Charlottetown Boulevard.
decided: Scarborough Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 40 km/h to 30 km/h on Charlottetown Boulevard, between Conference Boulevard and Lawrence Avenue East.
